name: Citizenship by Descent / Birth

requirement_groups.name: One or both parents Slovenian citizens

requirements.blocker_text: Citizenship Act of the Republic of Slovenia: a child acquires citizenship at birth if one or both parents are Slovenian citizens. If born abroad to one Slovenian and one foreign parent, the child must be registered as a Slovenian citizen before turning 18, or must settle permanently in Slovenia with the Slovenian parent before then.
requirements.fix_path: Register the child as a Slovenian citizen with a consulate, or settle permanently in Slovenia with the Slovenian parent, before the child turns 18 (for the mixed-parentage, born-abroad case).

requirement_groups.name: Born in Slovenia to unknown or stateless parents

requirements.blocker_text: Children born in Slovenia to unknown parents or to stateless parents acquire Slovenian citizenship automatically -- a statelessness safeguard.

sources.title: Uradni list Republike Slovenije (Official Gazette of the Republic of Slovenia) -- Zakon o drzavljanstvu Republike Slovenije (Citizenship Act), descent/birth and naturalization provisions
